visual_summary: A chaotic aerial attack unfolds over stone ruins or a castle-like complex. An armored figure and a small robot or craft companion move through flying debris while a sleek black aircraft fires or drops munitions into the site, causing multiple explosions. In a cockpit close-up, a large helmeted warrior speaks forcefully to a frightened young passenger with visible mechanical eyes. The page ends with the aircraft flying over the ruined area as the warrior dismisses the passenger's grief and demands to continue the battle.
